$comment: THE SHARED CONFORMANCE CORPUS for the deployment failure taxonomy.
(the console imports it) and scripts/ci/deploy-classify.mjs (CI imports it) — because a
.mjs cannot import a .ts and the console cannot import from scripts/ (its image build
context is apps/fiab-console). Duplicating an algorithm is exactly as dangerous as
duplicating a table, so both implementations are pinned to THIS file:
Either drifting turns its own suite red. A byte-compare of two tables would not have
caught an algorithm drift; this does.
EVERY `input` here is a string Azure/az was OBSERVED to emit — the `source` field says
where. Do not add a guessed input: a wrong expectation is worse than no expectation,
because it makes a misclassification look tested.
